On the Water

Private outings are just the beginning

A private outing with your own guests is one option once you are a member, and a very good one. It is not the whole club. Members choose the shape of the day, and the club handles everything else, including making it look effortless. Every outing below, and everything else on this page, is members only.

The Signature

The Skyline Cruise

Four unhurried hours touring Miami from the only angle that does it justice: the water. Skyline, islands, and that light the city saves for people on yachts.

Four hours · Members & invited guests
The Exhale

Anchor & Unwind

Out to a quiet anchorage, hook down, world off. Swim, float, graze, and do absolutely nothing at a very high standard for four glorious hours.

Four hours · Swim platform down
The Arrival

The Waterfront Table

Cruise to dinner at one of Miami's waterfront restaurants and arrive the way entrances were invented for. Everyone at the host stand will notice. That is fine.

Evening outing · Arrive by yacht

Club Occasions

One yacht. Any occasion worth dressing for.

Starship V is a setting, not just a boat, and the club is open to almost anything a member can imagine doing beautifully on the water. A private cruise is one way to use her. She has just as much range as her members do.

  • Fashion shows, designer previews, and collection launches
  • Movie premieres and private screenings under the sky
  • Brand evenings, press gatherings, and product reveals
  • Birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, and reunions
  • Charity evenings and holiday parties, done properly
  • And whatever a member dreams up next. Bring the idea, the club brings the yacht

One rule covers all of it, and it never bends: members only. Every occasion, every outing, every guest list starts with membership. If the public could come, it would not be Legacy.

LEGACY

A private, invitation-only yacht club aboard Starship V. A country club on the water, berthed at Venetian Marina, Miami.
